paper: CuRe: Learning Continuous Source Responses for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection (arXiv 2609.14316)
training_set_in_paper: Trained only on GenImage SD-v1.4. The paper's two-stage mixing-ratio-regression training recipe is not in the official release, so only the official adapter (weights) is evaluated here; there is no SynthScope-trained checkpoint.

benchmarks.name: AIGIBench (20 full-image-synthesis subsets, full test data)

paper_number.note: Paper Table 2: unweighted macro-average over the 20 full-image-synthesis subsets.

our_number.note: Official adapter through SynthScope reproduces every one of the 20 subsets within 0.10 pt (92.85 acc / 97.48 AUROC).

paper_number.note: Paper reports 82.0 for 'UnivFD' but does not specify the aggregation, so it is not directly comparable to the per-generator mean measured here.

our_number.note: UFD-8 mean balanced accuracy 93.94; 16-generator union 89.27 (aggregation differs from the paper).

paper_number.note: GAN half of the paper's UnivFD number (82.0); aggregation unspecified.

our_number.note: Mean balanced accuracy 81.95 (low scores are fake-recall; AP/AUROC are 95-99 on those generators).
